name: UTS Grocery and Food Vouchers
summary: Grocery vouchers and Opal travel credit for UTS students in financial hardship.
who: Financial hardship, or regular income under $1,200 per fortnight while living away from home, with inadequate savings
how: Call 02 9514 1177 to book an on-campus appointment
catches: Cards must be collected in person at Broadway

evidence.quote: You must be able to collect the cards, in person, from our UTS Broadway Sydney campus.
